clips.end_words: So that's when do you meditate
clips.caption:
There's no wrong time to meditate — any time counts, and doing it badly beats not doing it at all. But there are two windows that change what it actually does for you.

Morning, before breakfast, before the day has a chance to program you: it energizes you, sharpens your focus, and tends to set the whole day on a different track.

Afternoon, before dinner: it clears out whatever the day loaded into you — the stress, the tension — before you walk through your own front door and hand it to the people you live with.
